description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性
description.en: Used to ensure the idempotency of the request.
The Kibana private network connection ID.

descriptions.zh:
1. 此API仅支持云原生实例，老架构实例请使用TriggerNetwork方法
2. kibana 规格需大于1核2G
descriptions.en:
1. This API operation supports only cloud-native instances. For instances of the legacy architecture, use the TriggerNetwork operation.
2. The Kibana specifications must be greater than 1 vCPU and 2 GB of memory.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch update-kibana-pvl-network --instance-id es-cn-vo93ngti8000a0000 --pvl-id es-cn-vo93ngti8000a0000-kibana-internal-internal --client-token xxxx --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
